description: Search 791 lab-measured tennis strings by name, brand, material and gauge, sorted by a measurement or by price. Each result carries stiffness (lb/in), tension loss (%), energy return (%), spin potential, ball bite and string friction, each with its percentile in the database, plus the current retail price, a buy link and the StringSpec page. Returns at most 10 strings; narrow the filters rather than asking for more.

gauge.description: Gauge label. A higher number is thinner, and an "L" gauge is thinner than its base (17L is thinner than 17).

include_discontinued.description: Include strings no longer sold (default false).

material.description: Construction family. Polyester is the stiff spin-friendly monofilament; Nylon covers synthetic gut and multifilaments; Gut is natural gut.

max_price_usd.description: Only strings with a retail set price at or under this, in USD. Strings without a price are excluded when this is set.

query.description: Words from the string's name, e.g. "alu power", "hyper-g", "rpm blast".

sort.description: popular (a retailer's units-sold order, default), softest, stiffest, most_spin, best_tension_hold, most_power (energy return), cheapest.

name: search_strings
title: Search tennis strings
